title: Remediate LiteLLM proxy SQL injection advisory in dspy optional dependency chain

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented LiteLLM advisory remediation for dspy optional dependency chain: set litellm>=1.83.7 in pyproject and regenerated lockfile to litellm 1.83.14. Validation: snyk test (default and --dev) reports no vulnerable paths; pytest -q passes (442).
